description: This file contains the implementation of the AnalyticsImplementation class, including methods for configuring analytics, sending events, managing event queues, and mapping event names. It also defines internal classes and functions related to analytics backend integration, event processing, and configuration parsing.

classes.name: AnalyticsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for analytics settings, including event map and backend library path.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing analytics event handling, configuration, backend communication, and event mapping.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper
classes.description: Helper class for mapping event names based on configuration JSON.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::SendEvent
methods.description: Public method to enqueue an event for sending, with validation and logging.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics system with the provided shell, loads configuration, and initializes backends.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ActionLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread to process queued actions such as sending events and updating system time.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the system time is valid and synchronized.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Converts internal event to backend event format and sends it via the backend interface.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ParseEventsMapFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the event mapping JSON file.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Returns current system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts an uptime value to a system timestamp.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper::FromString
methods.description: Parses JSON array string to populate event name mappings.

methods.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper::MapEventNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Maps an event name based on configuration, with fallback options.
